title: Customer Onboarding for Remote Cheque Deposit (RCD) Feature
description: Retail banking customers must complete a one-time enrollment to activate the Remote Cheque Deposit feature on their mobile app. Enrollment requires the customer to accept the RCD Terms and Conditions, confirm their eligible account (current or savings), and pass an identity re-verification step using biometric (fingerprint/face ID) or OTP sent to the registered mobile number. Only customers with accounts older than 90 days and no active fraud flags are eligible.
acceptance_criteria: Customer sees RCD enrollment prompt on first navigation to Deposit section; Eligibility check runs silently before showing enrollment  ineligible customers see explanation message; Terms and Conditions displayed in full with scroll-to-bottom requirement before Accept button activates; Biometric re-verification attempted first falls back to OTP if biometric unavailable; OTP delivered within 60 seconds to registered mobile number; Accounts less than 90 days old shown specific ineligibility reason; Customers with active fraud flags shown generic ineligibility message without disclosing fraud flag; Successful enrollment confirmation shown with daily and per-cheque deposit limits; Enrollment status persisted” re-verification not required on subsequent sessions

title: Camera-Assisted Cheque Capture” Front Image
description: The mobile app must provide a guided camera interface to capture the front face of a physical cheque. The interface must use real-time image analysis to assist the customer in positioning the cheque correctly before capture. The system must detect cheque boundaries, assess image quality (focus, brightness, glare), and auto-capture when all quality thresholds are met. Manual shutter trigger must also be available. The captured image must be pre-processed (deskewed, cropped, contrast-enhanced) before submission.
acceptance_criteria: Camera launches in landscape orientation with cheque-shaped overlay guide; Real-time boundary detection highlights cheque edges in green when fully within frame; Brightness indicator warns if lighting is too low (< 100 lux equivalent) or causes glare; Focus quality indicator shown” auto-capture blocked until focus score > 85%; Auto-capture triggers within 2 seconds of all quality thresholds being met; Manual capture button always available regardless of quality indicators; Captured image auto-cropped to detected cheque boundary with 5px padding; Image deskewed if tilt angle > 2 degrees; Contrast enhancement applied if histogram spread < 40%; Preview shown after capture with option to Retake or Proceed; Minimum image resolution 1200x600 pixels enforced; Image file size compressed to under 2MB before upload without quality loss

title: Camera-Assisted Cheque Capture” Back Image (Endorsement)
description: After capturing the front image, the app must prompt the customer to flip the cheque and capture the back (endorsement) side. The back must show the customer's signature and the pre-printed endorsement stamp if required by the bank's policy. The interface must verify that the endorsement area is visible and legible. The system must detect if the back image is actually the front image re-submitted and reject it.
acceptance_criteria: Sequential flow enforced” back capture screen appears only after front accepted; Overlay guide shows endorsement area zone with instruction text; App detects if customer submits front image again as back (MICR line detection) and shows error; Endorsement area legibility check” minimum text contrast ratio 4.5:1 required; Warning shown if endorsement signature area appears blank” customer can proceed with acknowledgement; Both images associated with same cheque deposit transaction ID; Session timeout of 5 minutes applies to capture flow” incomplete captures discarded; Accessibility: VoiceOver/TalkBack instructions guide visually impaired users through capture steps

title: Optical Character Recognition (OCR)” Cheque Data Extraction
description: Upon successful dual-image capture, the system must perform OCR to extract key cheque fields: Payee Name, Cheque Date, Amount in Figures, Amount in Words, Drawer Account Number, Bank Name, Branch Name, and MICR Code Line (containing cheque number, MICR code, and account number). Extraction must complete within 10 seconds. Confidence scores must be computed per field” low-confidence fields must be flagged for customer review.
acceptance_criteria: OCR processing initiated immediately after both images confirmed; Processing spinner shown with estimated time; All 8 cheque fields attempted for extraction; Confidence score computed per field (0 100%); Fields with confidence < 75% highlighted in yellow for customer review; Fields with confidence < 40% left blank for mandatory customer entry; Amount in Figures and Amount in Words cross-validated” mismatch flagged; MICR line parsed into three segments: cheque number (6 digits), MICR code (9 digits), account number; Payee name matched against customer's registered name” mismatch shown as warning not blocker; OCR completes within 10 seconds on standard 4G connection; OCR failure (all fields < 40%) falls back to fully manual entry mode with error message; Extracted data shown in editable form for customer confirmation

title: Manual Cheque Data Entry Mode
description: Customers must be able to bypass camera capture entirely and enter cheque details manually. Manual mode must be accessible from the home deposit screen and from the camera capture screen. The manual entry form must include all required cheque fields with appropriate input types, format validation, and inline help. Manual entry cheques are subject to additional processing time and a lower daily deposit limit compared to camera-captured cheques.
acceptance_criteria: Manual entry option prominently displayed as alternative to camera on deposit home screen; Form fields: Payee Name (text), Cheque Date (date picker” no future dates), Amount (numeric with decimal), Cheque Number (6-digit numeric), Drawer Bank Name (searchable dropdown of 200+ banks), MICR Code (9-digit numeric), Drawer Account Number (9 18 digit numeric); All fields validated on blur with inline error messages; Amount in Words auto-generated from numeric amount and shown for customer confirmation; Cheque Number format validated as exactly 6 digits; MICR Code validated as exactly 9 digits; Date validation: cheque not older than 6 months, not post-dated beyond 3 months; Manual entry deposits flagged in system with processing_type = MANUAL; Manual entry daily limit: 50% of camera capture daily limit; Submission disabled until all required fields pass validation

title: Cheque Amount Validation and Deposit Limits
description: The system must enforce multi-layered deposit limit controls: per-cheque maximum, daily aggregate limit, and monthly aggregate limit. Limits must vary by customer tier (Standard, Silver, Gold, Platinum). The system must check real-time against already-processed and pending deposits for the current day and month. Attempted deposits exceeding limits must be rejected before processing with a clear message showing current usage and limits.
acceptance_criteria: Per-cheque limits by tier: Standard 25,000 / Silver 50,000 / Gold 1,00,000 / Platinum 5,00,000; Daily aggregate limits by tier: Standard 50,000 / Silver 1,00,000 / Gold 3,00,000 / Platinum 10,00,000; Monthly aggregate limits: 3x the daily limit for each tier; Limits checked against pending + processed deposits (not just cleared); Rejection message shows: attempted amount, current day total, remaining daily limit, monthly total, remaining monthly limit; Cheque amount must be > 100 (minimum deposit); Amount in figures must match amount in words” mismatch blocks submission; Amounts above 2,00,000 trigger additional confirmation step per RBI guidelines; Zero-amount cheques rejected; Fractional paisa amounts rejected (only whole rupee amounts accepted)

title: Duplicate Cheque Detection
description: The system must detect and reject duplicate cheque submissions to prevent double-deposits. Duplicate detection must use a combination of cheque number, drawer account number, and cheque amount. Detection must cover: same session re-submission, previous submissions within 90 days, and cross-customer submissions of the same cheque. Suspected duplicates must be flagged for manual review by the bank's operations team rather than auto-rejected if the confidence is below 95%.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate check runs before any processing” synchronous, within 2 seconds; Primary key for duplicate: cheque_number + drawer_account_number + amount; High-confidence duplicate (>95% match): auto-rejected with message showing previous deposit date and reference number; Medium-confidence suspected duplicate (70 95%): customer shown warning, must confirm to proceed; submission flagged for ops review; Low-confidence (<70%): proceeds normally, soft flag logged; Duplicate check covers 90-day rolling window; Cross-customer duplicate (same cheque deposited by different customer): auto-rejected, both customers' accounts flagged, ops team alerted; Same-session duplicate (customer hits back and resubmits) detected by session token; Duplicate rejection does not consume customer's daily deposit count

title: Cheque Image Quality Re-Validation at Server Side
description: After client-side image capture and upload, the bank's server must independently re-validate both cheque images for quality, authenticity markers, and compliance. Server-side checks include: resolution verification, MICR band visibility, security feature detection (watermarks, microprinting), and detection of digitally generated or printed cheques (as opposed to genuine bank-issued cheque stock). Suspicious images must be quarantined and reviewed by the fraud team.
acceptance_criteria: Server re-validates image resolution: minimum 200 DPI required for processing; MICR band (bottom strip) must be clearly visible in front image” missing MICR triggers rejection; Server checks for known security features: UV-reactive band pattern hash, watermark presence (bank-specific); Digitally generated cheque detection: printer artifact analysis, pixel uniformity check” suspected fake score computed; Fake score > 80%: auto-rejected, transaction flagged, fraud team alerted, customer shown generic 'unable to process' message; Fake score 50 80%: quarantined for manual review within 4 business hours; Server validation completes within 15 seconds; All server validation results logged with scores for audit; Images stored encrypted (AES-256) for 7 years per RBI mandate; Customer notified of rejection via push notification and in-app message within 2 minutes

title: Cheque Processing Workflow and Status Tracking
description: Accepted cheque deposits must enter a defined processing pipeline: Submitted â†’ Under Review â†’ Sent to Clearing â†’ Funds on Hold â†’ Cleared â†’ Credited. The customer must be able to track their deposit status in real-time within the app. Each status transition must trigger an in-app notification and SMS. The system must provide estimated credit date based on cheque type (local/outstation/MICR/non-MICR) and cutoff times.
acceptance_criteria: Status pipeline enforced sequentially” no backward transitions except Returned and Rejected; Status visible in Deposit History with colour-coded badges; Real-time status push notification on every transition; SMS sent on: Submitted, Cleared, Credited, Returned, Rejected; Estimated credit date shown from Submitted status based on: local MICR cheque = T+1, outstation MICR = T+2, non-MICR = T+3; Cutoff time: submissions before 2:00 PM IST counted as same-day (T+0); Submissions after 2:00 PM treated as next business day; Public holidays excluded from T+N calculation using RBI holiday calendar; Returned cheques show return reason code and description; Credited status shows exact credit timestamp and updated account balance; Processing SLA breach alerts sent to ops team if status stuck for >4 hours

title: Funds Hold and Provisional Credit Policy
description: Upon cheque submission, the deposited amount must be placed on a hold in the customer's account” visible in available balance as a pending credit. The hold amount must be clearly distinguished from cleared funds in the account balance display. Partial provisional credit (up to 10,000 or 20% of cheque amount, whichever is lower) may be released for eligible Platinum and Gold customers immediately. Full credit released only after clearing confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Deposited amount shown in account summary as 'Pending Cheque Credit' with cheque reference; Available balance = ledger balance minus holds plus cleared credits; Pending amount excluded from available balance used for debit transactions; Provisional credit eligibility: Gold and Platinum tiers only; Provisional credit amount = min(â‚ 10,000, 20% of cheque amount); Provisional credit released within 30 minutes of submission for eligible customers; Provisional credit clearly labelled in transaction history as 'Provisional” subject to clearing'; If cheque returned: provisional credit reversed, customer notified, reversal shown in transaction history; Full credit posted with value date = clearing date; Interest on savings accounts calculated on cleared balance only

title: Cheque Return Handling and Customer Notification
description: If a deposited cheque is returned unpaid by the drawer's bank, the system must immediately reverse any provisional credit, debit the full cheque amount from the customer's account (if already credited), notify the customer with the return reason, and make the physical cheque image available for download. Return reasons must use standard CTS-2010 return codes mapped to plain-English descriptions. Customers must be able to initiate a dispute within 30 days.
acceptance_criteria: Returned cheque triggers: reversal of provisional credit (if any), debit of full amount (if credited), status update to Returned; Reversal transaction created in account history with reference to original deposit; Customer notified via push, SMS, and in-app message within 15 minutes of return receipt; Notification includes: return reason code, plain-English description, cheque details, date of return; Standard return codes mapped: 01=Funds Insufficient, 02=Exceed Arrangement, 03=Effects Not Cleared, 08=Signature Mismatch, 28=Stale Cheque etc.; Both cheque images (front and back) available for download for 90 days after return; Returned cheque does not count against customer's daily deposit limit; Customer can initiate dispute from returned cheque detail screen; Dispute form captures: reason, additional remarks, contact preference; Dispute acknowledged within 2 business hours

title: Multi-Account Deposit Routing
description: Customers who hold multiple eligible accounts (current, savings) must be able to select which account receives the cheque deposit. The account selector must show account nickname, account number (masked), account type, current available balance, and applicable deposit limits. The payee name on the cheque must be cross-validated against the name on the selected account. Cross-account deposits (cheque payable to Account A deposited into Account B) must require explicit customer declaration.
acceptance_criteria: Account selector displayed before camera/manual entry” pre-populated with default account; All eligible accounts listed with: nickname, masked account (last 4 digits), type, available balance, remaining daily RCD limit; Accounts with zero remaining daily limit shown but disabled with 'Limit reached' label; Payee name on cheque cross-matched with selected account holder name; Exact match or fuzzy match >85%: proceeds normally; Match 60 85%: customer shown name comparison and must confirm; Match <60%: cross-account declaration modal” customer must check declaration checkbox and enter OTP; Joint accounts: payee name matched against either holder; Account selection can be changed until final submission; Selected account shown on review screen before submission

title: Regulatory Compliance” RBI and KYC Requirements
description: All Remote Cheque Deposit transactions must comply with Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines for mobile banking and cheque truncation. Specifically: transactions above 2,00,000 require enhanced due diligence confirmation, all transactions must be logged in the bank's AML monitoring system within 5 minutes, customers with incomplete KYC must be restricted to 10,000 per transaction, and all cheque images must be stored per CTS-2010 standards.
acceptance_criteria: RBI mobile banking transaction limits enforced per current circular; Amounts â‰¥ 2,00,000: customer must re-authenticate (biometric or OTP) and confirm purpose of transaction from dropdown (Vendor Payment, Rent, Personal, Other); AML log entry created within 5 minutes of submission with: customer ID, account number, cheque amount, payee bank, drawer bank, transaction timestamp; Incomplete KYC customers: per-transaction limit 10,000, daily limit 10,000; KYC status check performed at each session start; Cheque images stored in CTS-2010 compliant format: 200 DPI minimum, grayscale front, black-and-white MICR band; Images retained for 7 years per RBI mandate; Transaction audit trail immutable” no delete/update permitted; Quarterly RCD usage reports generated for RBI submission; System downtime for RCD must be reported to RBI if exceeding 4 continuous hours

title: Security” Session Management and Anti-Tampering for RCD
description: The RCD feature must implement enhanced security controls beyond standard mobile banking: image transmission must use certificate pinning, all cheque images must be watermarked with customer ID and timestamp before upload, the camera interface must block screenshots and screen recording, and the app must detect rooted/jailbroken devices and disable RCD on such devices. Session for RCD must have a hard timeout of 10 minutes from initiation.
acceptance_criteria: Certificate pinning enforced for all RCD API endpoints” invalid certificate aborts session; Cheque images watermarked server-side with: customer ID hash, timestamp, device ID hash before storage; Screenshot and screen recording blocked on camera capture and review screens (Android FLAG_SECURE, iOS UIScreen.isCaptured); Rooted/jailbroken device detection: RCD feature disabled, customer shown advisory message with helpdesk number; RCD session hard timeout: 10 minutes from first screen” countdown shown in last 2 minutes; Session timeout discards all captured images and entered data; Anti-replay: each RCD session has unique nonce” duplicate submissions with same nonce rejected; Image upload uses multipart encrypted stream” interrupted uploads auto-resumed for up to 5 minutes; Failed security checks logged with device fingerprint for fraud analytics; Emulator detection: RCD blocked on emulated devices

title: Deposit History and Detailed Transaction View
description: Customers must be able to view a complete history of all their RCD submissions with filtering and search capabilities. Each deposit record must show status, amount, dates, and allow viewing of cheque images. The history must be available for 13 months (rolling). Customers must be able to download a deposit confirmation certificate (PDF) for any cleared deposit, which serves as proof of deposit for accounting purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Deposit history accessible from Deposits > History menu; History shows: deposit reference number, cheque number, amount, payee bank, submission date, current status, credit date (if cleared); Filter by: date range (custom + presets), status, amount range, account; Search by cheque number or reference number; Results paginated” 20 per page, sorted newest first; Tapping a record shows full detail: all cheque fields, both cheque images (front and back thumbnails with pinch-to-zoom), complete status timeline with timestamps; Images available for 13 months then archived (request-only); Download Confirmation Certificate (PDF) available for Cleared and Credited status only; PDF contains: bank letterhead, customer name, account number, cheque details, deposit reference, credit date, authorised signatory block; PDF generated within 10 seconds; Certificate download logged in audit trail

title: Push Notifications and In-App Alerts for RCD Events
description: The system must deliver timely push notifications and in-app alerts for all significant RCD events. Notifications must be actionable” tapping them must deep-link to the relevant transaction. Customers must be able to configure notification preferences per event type. Critical events (return, fraud flag) must also trigger SMS regardless of push notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Push notifications sent for: Submission Confirmed, Under Review, Sent to Clearing, Funds on Hold, Cleared, Credited, Returned, Rejected, Limit Reached Warning (at 80% of daily limit); Notification content: event type, cheque amount, reference number, timestamp, action prompt; Deep link from notification opens specific transaction detail screen; In-app notification bell badge increments for unread RCD notifications; Notification preferences screen allows per-event-type toggle (push on/off); SMS mandatory (non-configurable) for: Returned, Rejected, Fraud Flagged; SMS content under 160 characters” includes reference number and helpdesk number; Notifications delivered within 2 minutes of event trigger; Notification delivery status logged” failed deliveries retried 3 times; Do Not Disturb hours (configurable 10 PM 7 AM) suppress push but not SMS for critical events

title: Helpdesk Integration and Dispute Resolution for RCD
description: Customers must be able to raise a service request directly from any RCD transaction, pre-populated with transaction details. Service requests must be categorised: Deposit not credited, Wrong amount credited, Cheque returned” disagree with reason, Technical issue during capture. SLA for first response: 2 business hours. Resolution SLA: 3 business days. Customers must receive status updates on their service request within the app.
acceptance_criteria: Raise Request button available on every RCD transaction detail screen; Service request form pre-populated: transaction reference, cheque number, amount, submission date, current status; Customer selects issue category from dropdown; Free-text description field (max 500 chars); Option to attach additional images (max 3, 5MB each); Service request confirmation with SR number shown immediately; SR number delivered via push notification and SMS; Status updates pushed to customer: Received, In Progress, Resolved, Closed; Customer can add comments to open SR from within app; Resolved SR shows resolution summary and resolution date; Customer can reopen SR within 7 days of resolution; Escalation auto-triggered if SR not updated for > 1 business day; All SRs linked to transaction in ops team view
